entries.label: fmt, host and wasm32 clippy, boundaries, physician-sample lib, source_check_and_reconnect, worker
command:
set -euo pipefail
    cargo fmt --all --check
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --quiet -- -D warnings
    cargo clippy -p physician-app -p duet-app -p mobile -p ui-gallery --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features physician-app/web,duet-app/web,mobile/web,ui-gallery/web --quiet -- -D warnings
    cargo test -p boundaries
    cargo test -p physician-sample --lib
    cargo test -p physician-sample --test source_check_and_reconnect
    cargo test -p physician-sample --test worker -- --test-threads=4
